name: When should I hire a commercial project manager for my luxury home build?

mainEntity.name: When should I hire a commercial project manager for my luxury home build?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is advisable to engage a commercial project manager as early as possible, ideally during the initial design and planning phase. Their involvement from the outset allows for crucial input on feasibility, cost-effectiveness, and potential challenges. Early engagement helps establish a realistic budget and timeline, optimizes material selection, and ensures seamless coordination with architects, designers, and engineers, preventing costly revisions later in the project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engage a commercial project manager early in the design and planning phase to ensure feasibility, cost-effectiveness, and smooth coordination.
